title: DelayLess
description: This is a PvP oriented modpack for 1.21.11, no restricted mods
body:
# DelayLess : PvP Oriented Modpack
## Modified UI
This modpack contains modified UI with FancyMenu. I would recommend playing on FullHD (1920*1080) screen resolution, the UI hasn't been adapted to other resolutions and could be sometimes off.

## Custom Server List
Apart from the modified UI, there is a custom server list with a total of 130 preset servers. It features every testing server for MCTiers, PvPTiers and Cart and Bed SubTiers.
To find the right server, you can search in the search bar its name or choose with the following filters : 
* Region : EU, NAE, NAC, NAW, SA, RU, AS, AU
* Gamemode : Crystal, Mace, SMP, Axe, Sword, UHC, Diapot, Nethpot, Cart, Bed
* Cracked
* Minigames
* Whitelisted
* Testing servers
Moreover, for easier navigation, you can favourite the server you play the most.

## Restricted mods
This modpack doesn't contain any restricted mods, so it's totally safe to use on any server with the following considerations : 
* Shield Statuses : banned in tier tests in some shield modes
* Hero's Anchor Optimizer : banned in PvPTiers crystal tier tests and in FlowPvP

## Recommended additions
I would personally recommend adding "Ravenclaw's Ping Equilizer" and "Mas Effect Updated" for better experience. (I couldn't add them here because of CR)

## This is a modpack
You can add any mods, resource packs, and configurate it however you want. You can use it as a template for your own modpacks, modify it and republish the modification with crediting me and the mods' creators.

## Works out of the box
Essential resource packs are provided, basic configuration is done, so all you have to do is copy-paste your options.txt. There will be a video of basic gameplay with the default configuration below. (my gameplay is a bit rusty because at the moment of recording, I just woke up)

## Extra Features
### Resource Pack Profiles
With the "Resource Pack Loader" mod, you can set automatic resource pack switch depending on the server you're playing.
### Optimizers
This modpack includes the following optimizers : 
* Marlow's Crystal Optimizer
* Hero's Anchor Optimizer
### Essential mod
I think this is pretty obvious : zoom, screenshot viewer, etc.
### Client Time 
You can set the in-game time and weather to whatever you want, regardless of the server or world.
### Anti Server Resource Pack
By toggling on this mod, you can ignore server resource packs, even if they're not optional.
### CPM and Hide Armor Mod
You can make a 3D model for your skin with "Customizable Player Models" and modify the visibility of your armor to adapt to it.
### Basic GUI Mods
The most basic and essential HUDs are present and it should be enough for casual gameplay.
### Keybind viewer
If you go to **Options -> Controls -> Key Binds -> Bind Viewer**, you can easily screenshot all of your binds in a readable way.
### In-game tierlist viewer
In the main menu and game pause menu, you can look at the MCTiers, PvPTiers and SubTiers websites for rankings.

## Contact
If you have any issues, questions or suggestions, DM me in Discord : @dafffod. This modpack is linked to my Discord server, where you can also contact me.
